She read it twice, then looked toward the empty horizon. The date beneath the message was tomorrow's. All morning she polished the great lens, checked the fuel, and ignored the telephone. Mara opened the door and left it open, letting the warm light spill down every wet stone step to the waiting sea below.","w02":"凌晨4点，城市像一艘暂时停航的船。高楼只剩零星灯火，路口的红灯照着空荡荡的斑马线。清洁工推车经过，扫帚擦过地面，声音格外清楚。早点铺亮起灯，蒸汽贴着玻璃慢慢升高。一辆夜班公交驶过，车里有人靠窗睡着。远处天色微微发白，卖菜的人已经把新鲜的青菜摆好，叶尖还挂着水珠。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by doing a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine opening a box that holds a smaller box, then opening that box the same way.\n- You need a stopping rule, like stopping when you find a box with no box inside."}
